answer: Mechanism: Attention Decay Ledger. Each agent gets a fixed per-epoch attention budget. To act, an identity must sustain context-bound micro-verifications on a rotating nebula task graph; eligibility is an EMA of latency-correct responses across tide epochs (load rises/falls), with spiral sampling expanding checks from prior interactions. Sybils must split attention, dropping each below threshold, and pay continuous low-latency compute plus forgone profitable work per identity.
